import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Define the path to the GSL libraries
GSL_CBLAS_PATH = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
GSL_PATH = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL(GSL_CBLAS_PATH, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(GSL_PATH)

# Define constants
N = 10000
QUANTILES = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]

# Define the gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc function
class GslRstatQuantile(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatQuantile)
gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]

gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatQuantile)]

gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_add.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatQuantile)]

gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatQuantile)]

# Define the gsl_rng_alloc function
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

gsl.gsl_ran_rayleigh.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_ran_rayleigh.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double]

# Define the gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data function
gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

# Define the gsl_rng_default constant
gsl.gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_default")

def assert_test():
    # Allocate memory for data
    data = (ctypes.c_double * N)()

    # Allocate workspaces for quantiles
    workspaces = [gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_alloc(q) for q in QUANTILES]

    # Allocate RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_default)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate RNG.")

    # Generate data and update workspaces
    for i in range(N):
        value = gsl.gsl_ran_rayleigh(rng, 1.0)
        data[i] = value
        for workspace in workspaces:
            gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_add(value, workspace)

    # Sort data
    np_data = np.ctypeslib.as_array(data)
    np_data.sort()

    # Compute exact quantiles
    exact_quantiles = [
        gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data(data, 1, N, q) for q in QUANTILES
    ]

    # Compute estimated quantiles
    estimated_quantiles = [
        gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_get(workspace) for workspace in workspaces
    ]

    # Compute errors
    errors = [
        (estimated - exact) / exact for estimated, exact in zip(estimated_quantiles, exact_quantiles)
    ]

    # Print results
    print(f"The dataset is {np_data[:5]}...")
    for i, q in enumerate(QUANTILES):
        print(f"{q} quartile: exact = {exact_quantiles[i]:.5f}, estimated = {estimated_quantiles[i]:.5f}, error = {errors[i]:.6e}")

    # Free resources
    for workspace in workspaces:
        gsl.gsl_rstat_quantile_free(workspace)

    gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
